adjudication.rationale:
In `GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent`, the fallback logic was changed to:
```ts
const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```
When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the branch where fallback is intended), the `find` predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where `externalCalendarId` is `undefined`/`null`, so it will almost always return `undefined`. This effectively drops the destination calendar externalId that previously came from `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` (now an array). The same flawed pattern is also present in `deleteEvent`’s `calendarId` computation. This is a concrete, diff-introduced correctness issue.
